note: The curated seed of the collections catalogue (docs/v6/collections-catalog.md §2): names, ids, links and item samples written down by hand from Nosh's CollectionRegistry on Robinhood Chain (read on chain, 58 collections) and the ordinals collections the old etched site listed (web/public/catalogue/catalogue.json, 50); under `image` and `sample`, the public picture URLs the sources gave, each fetched and checked to answer an image on 2026-09-23 (a marketplace's logo — OpenSea's, Ordinals Wallet's icon inscription at the ordinals content gateway, Nosh's registry image; the ordinals content gateway for inscriptions; a token's own metadata through tokenURI on a public RPC, ipfs:// named on Filebase's gateway because ipfs.io and dweb.link no longer serve paths; the projects' own image services for Nouns (noun.pics) and Moonbirds (proof.xyz), whose contracts' tokenURI reverts on public RPCs); under `recorded`, what each source answered when the seed was written — a dated record, never the price now. `rate` is the sats-per-ETH reference read then, used only until a fresh one is read and flagged stale meanwhile. The catalogue refreshes the live figures from the sources and serves this file, flagged stale, when they do not answer.
